fencing_contract.uncertain_inflight: cancel/reap adapter command within existing bound then inspect immutable ownership; outcome unknown blocks cleanup rather than issuing conflicting duplicate

fencing_contract.client_transport: future broker-only AF_UNIX SOCK_STREAM at attempt_root/scratch/control/broker.sock, dir0700 socket0600; peer UID and full registered PID/start identity checked with SO_PEERCRED and process port; canonical JSON length-prefixed uint32 big-endian frames<=65536; wrong peer/frame/epoch rejected; scratch IPC is not an accepted evidence artifact
